description: Delete ~/.config/shipeasy/config.json — the ONE session shared by the `shipeasy` CLI and every MCP client on this machine. No network call. **This is not restorable from MCP**: re-authenticating needs a browser sign-in in a terminal (`shipeasy login`), which this transport cannot perform, so calling this strands the current task and every other tool until a human signs in again. Do NOT call it to 'reset' or troubleshoot a failing call — a 401/403 is fixed by signing in, not by deleting the credential first. Only call it when the user explicitly asked to sign out, and pass confirm: true to acknowledge that.

confirm.description: Must be true. Acknowledges that this deletes the machine-wide session and that only a human at a terminal can restore it.

name: auth_logout
